Timing of colibactin mutagenesis

R notebook for analyses associated with results section ‘Timing of colibactin mutagenesis’ in Marshall et al. Common early-life exposure of the colorectal epithelium to the microbiome-derived mutagen colibactin

library(ape)
library(dplyr)
library(ggtree)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')

a : construct pileup to facilitate timing analysis:

## compute_branch_sens computes per branch sensitivities based off coverage and median vaf
compute_branch_sens <- function(tree, tip_sens) {
  Ntip  <- Ntip(tree)
  Nnode <- tree$Nnode
  sens <- rep(NA_real_, Ntip + Nnode)
  
  # match tip sensitivities to tip order
  sens[1:Ntip] <- tip_sens[tree$tip.label,]
  
  po <- reorder.phylo(tree, "postorder")
  edges <- po$edge
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
    parent <- edges[i, 1]
    children <- edges[edges[,1] == parent, 2]
    
    if (all(!is.na(sens[children]))) {
      sens[parent] <- 1 - prod(1 - sens[children])
    }
  }
  return(sens)  # named by node index implicitly
}

##
tip_sens<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, sensitivitySBS)%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='sample')

# initiate a data frame for crypt pileup
dir='../snv_phylogenetic_trees/'
patients=list.files(dir)
crypt_pileup=NULL
sens_edge_compiled=NULL

for (patient in patients){
  if (file.exists(paste0(dir,patient,"/",patient,".tree_with_branch_length.tree"))){
  tree = read.tree(paste0(dir,patient,"/",patient,".tree_with_branch_length.tree"))
  
  # adjust branch lengths for sensitivity :
  sens_vec <- compute_branch_sens(tree, tip_sens)
  sens_df <- data.frame(node = seq_along(sens_vec),sens = sens_vec)
  edge_df <- as.data.frame(tree$edge)
  
  colnames(edge_df) <- c("parent", "child")
  edge_df <- merge(edge_df, sens_df,  by.x = "child", by.y = "node",  all.x = TRUE)%>%
    mutate(sens=replace_na(sens,1))
  edge_df$Samples=paste0(patient,'_',edge_df$child)
  sens_edge_compiled<-rbind(sens_edge_compiled,edge_df)

  tree_df=ggtree::fortify(tree)
  
  # pile up branches for each crypt :
  crypts=unique(tree_df$label)
  crypts=crypts[!is.na(crypts)]
  crypts=crypts[str_detect(crypts,'PD')]
  for (n in 1:length(crypts)){
    crypt=crypts[n]
    
    end_branch=tree_df[tree_df$label==crypt&!is.na(tree_df$label),]
    branch_pileup=end_branch
    branch=end_branch
    while (branch$node!=branch$parent){
      new_node=branch$parent
      new_branch=tree_df[tree_df$node==new_node,]
      branch_pileup<-rbind(branch_pileup,new_branch)
      branch=new_branch
    }
    branch_pileup$crypt=crypt
  
  crypt_pileup=rbind(crypt_pileup,branch_pileup)
  }
  } else { crypt_pileup= crypt_pileup }
}


crypt_pileup$patient=str_extract(crypt_pileup$crypt,'PD\\d{5}')
crypt_pileup$biopsy=str_extract(crypt_pileup$crypt,'PD\\d{5}\\w')
crypt_pileup$branch_id=paste(crypt_pileup$patient,crypt_pileup$node,sep="_")
crypt_pileup<-crypt_pileup%>%filter(!duplicated(paste0(crypt,branch_id)))
sens_edge_compiled<-sens_edge_compiled%>% dplyr::select(-parent,-child)

b : construct a dataframe for timing analysis

i : adjust mutational signature attributions for the sensitivity for each branch

## load in signature attribution to each branch branches attribution :
msa_branches<-read.csv('../Signatures/MSA_Attribution/pruned_attribution_paediatric_branches_SBS_abs_mutations.csv')%>%
  rename_with(.,~paste0(.x,'_branch'))

## construct a dataframe with signature attributions adjusted :
crypt_branch<-crypt_pileup %>% dplyr::select(biopsy, crypt, branch_id)
signature_attributions_compiled<-left_join(crypt_branch,msa_branches,by=c('branch_id'='X_branch')) %>%
  left_join(sens_edge_compiled,by=c('branch_id'='Samples'))%>%
  mutate(sens=replace_na(sens,1))%>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x,0)))%>%
  mutate(across(contains('SBS'),~round(.x,digits=3)),
         across(contains('SBS'), ~.x / sens))

ii : annotate the branches with sbs signature counts

## begin with the crypt pileup and combine with the attributions df :
crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-left_join(x=crypt_pileup, y=signature_attributions_compiled, by=c('biopsy','crypt','branch_id'))
positive_biopsies<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy,biopsy_colibactin_pos,patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  unique()

crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-left_join(crypt_pileup_sig_annotated,positive_biopsies,by='biopsy')

#crypt_pileup_sig_annotated_current_results <-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated  
## load in patient metadata
age_df=crypt_metadata%>%dplyr::select(patient,age)%>%unique()
colnames(age_df)<-c('patient','Age')

## construct a dataframe for creating relevant data time points :
crypt_pileup_sig_annotated=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated%>%
  
  # zero truncal mutations :
  mutate(across(contains("SBS"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)), # these are typically the root branches 
    muts_assigned=rowSums(pick(contains('_branch'))),
    across(contains('_branch'),~ifelse(muts_assigned>branch.length,(.x/muts_assigned)*branch.length,.x)),
    across(contains("_branch"),~ if_else(branch.length <= 50 & x<50, 0, .x)),
         SBSUnassigned = branch.length - rowSums(pick(contains('_branch'))))%>%
  
  arrange(crypt, x)%>%
  group_by(crypt)%>%
  
  # calculate the background mutaitons for a given branch
  mutate(background_muts_branch = SBS1_branch+SBS5_branch+SBSUnassigned) %>% # SBS18 dropped from estimatio of branch points
  
  # calculcate the total background mutations for the start and end points of a branch 
  mutate(background_muts_branch_end_msa  = cumsum(background_muts_branch),
         background_muts_branch_start_msa = background_muts_branch_end_msa - background_muts_branch) %>%
  
  
  # calculate the total mutations for the end of the branch and total background mutation for a crypt
  mutate(all_muts_count_branch_end_msa = cumsum(background_muts_branch + SBS88_branch),
         background_muts_crypt_total_msa = sum(background_muts_branch)) %>%
  ungroup()

create confidence intervals for the breakpoints in each phylogenetic trees to create confidence intervals, we perform a poisson test for the number of brackground mutations preceding that branch point against the total number of mutations for that crypt

## create confidence intervals :
branch_end_ci_mat<-t(mapply(function(x,n){
  pt=poisson.test(round(x,digits=0),round(n,digits=0))
  conf.intv=pt$conf.int * n},
  x=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_branch_end_msa,
  n=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_crypt_total_msa))

colnames(branch_end_ci_mat)<-c('background_muts_branch_end_lower_ci','background_muts_branch_end_upper_ci')

branch_start_ci_mat<-t(mapply(function(x,n){
  pt=poisson.test(round(x,digits=0),round(n,digits=0))
  conf.intv=pt$conf.int * n},
x=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_branch_start_msa,
n=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_crypt_total_msa))

colnames(branch_start_ci_mat)<-c('background_muts_branch_start_lower_ci','background_muts_branch_start_upper_ci')

crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-cbind(crypt_pileup_sig_annotated,branch_start_ci_mat,branch_end_ci_mat)

determine per crypt rates of background mutations

## select age for each biopsy
age_df<-unique(subset(crypt_metadata,names=c('biopsy','age')))
Warning: In subset.data.frame(crypt_metadata, names = c("biopsy", "age")) :

## determine background mutation rates
background_mut_rates<-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated%>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy,crypt,background_muts_crypt_total_msa)%>%
  unique()%>%
  left_join(.,age_df,by=c('biopsy'='biopsy'))%>%
  mutate(background_muts_rate_msa=background_muts_crypt_total_msa/age)%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt,background_muts_rate_msa,age)
crypt_pileup_classification<-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  left_join(unpruned_weights,by=c('branch_id'='Sample'))%>%
  # identify negative branches that follow positive branches
  group_by(crypt) %>%
  mutate(parent_branch_id=paste0(patient,"_",parent),
         branch_status=case_when(branch.length <= 50 & x<50~'Truncal',
                                 sum(SBS88_branch > 0) ==0~'Negative Crypt',
                                 sum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 0 & cumsum(SBS88_branch>0)==0~'Pre exposure',
                                 cumsum(SBS88_branch>0)==1 & SBS88_branch>0~'First positive branch',
                                 cumsum(SBS88_branch>0)>1 & SBS88_branch>0~'Second positive branch',
                                 cumsum(SBS88_branch>0)>0 & SBS88_branch==0 & SBS88_unpruned==0&branch.length>80~'Post cessation branch',
                                 (cumsum(SBS88_branch>0)>0 & SBS88_branch==0) & (SBS88_unpruned>0 | branch.length<80)~'Post cessation branch - Indeterminant',
                                 TRUE~'other')
                                 
                                 )%>%
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  #left_join(id_burdens, by ='branch_id',fill) %>%
  mutate(
    #id_burden=replace_na(id_burden,0),
         across(contains('background_muts_branch'), ~.x/ background_muts_rate_msa,.names='age_{.col}'),
         branch_duration=age_background_muts_branch_end_msa - age_background_muts_branch_start_msa,
         #id_rate=id_burden/branch_duration
         )
crypt_classification_long<-crypt_pileup_classification%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,crypt,branch_id, parent_branch_id,branch_status,age_background_muts_branch_start_msa,age_background_muts_branch_end_msa,age)%>%
  filter(branch_status%in%c('First positive branch','Second positive branch','Post cessation branch'))%>%
  
  # link branches that come from the same preceding branch:
  group_by(parent_branch_id)%>%
  mutate(age_background_muts_branch_start_msa=min(age_background_muts_branch_start_msa))%>%
  
  # for end of branches :
  group_by(branch_id)%>%
  mutate(age_background_muts_branch_end_msa=min(age_background_muts_branch_end_msa))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=contains('age'))%>%
  mutate(timepoint=case_when(branch_status=='First positive branch'&name=='age_background_muts_branch_start_msa'~'age_earliest_commencement',
                             branch_status=='First positive branch'&name=='age_background_muts_branch_end_msa'~'age_latest_commencement',
                             branch_status=='Second positive branch'&name=='age_background_muts_branch_start_msa'~'age_continuation',
                             branch_status=='Post cessation branch'&name=='age_background_muts_branch_start_msa'~'age_cessation',
                             branch_status=='First positive branch'&name=='age'~'donor_age',
                             .default='Other'
                             ))%>%
  filter(timepoint!='Other')%>%
  dplyr::select(-branch_id)%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,crypt,timepoint,value)%>%
  group_by(crypt)%>%
  filter(sum(timepoint=='age_cessation'|timepoint=='age_continuation')>0) # subset only those crypts with informative timepoints

patient_order <- crypt_classification_long %>%
  filter(timepoint=='donor_age')%>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(donor_age = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(donor_age))


swimmers_crypt_order<-crypt_classification_long%>%
  filter(!duplicated(crypt))%>%
  mutate(patient_f = factor(patient, levels = patient_order$patient))%>%
  arrange(patient_f, desc(age)) %>%
  group_by(patient_f) %>%
  mutate(ypos = seq(1.5, by = 0.5, length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt,ypos)


earliest_commencement<-crypt_classification_long%>%
  filter(timepoint=='age_earliest_commencement')%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt,value)
colnames(earliest_commencement)<-c('crypt','age_earliest_commencement')

swimmers_crypt_df <- crypt_classification_long %>%
  left_join(patient_order)%>%
  left_join(swimmers_crypt_order)%>%
  left_join(earliest_commencement,by=c('crypt'))%>%
  mutate(patient_f = factor(patient, levels = patient_order$patient))%>%
  arrange(patient_f, desc(age))%>%
  filter(!timepoint%in%c('donor_age','age_latest_commencement'))
Joining with `by = join_by(patient)`Joining with `by = join_by(crypt)`

crypt_bar_plot<-swimmers_crypt_df%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,patient_f,crypt,donor_age,crypt,timepoint,value,starts_with('age_'),ypos)%>%
  filter(!is.na(value))%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,patient_f, crypt,donor_age, age_earliest_commencement,

png('~/crypt_by_crypt_swimmers_plot.png',width=2800,height=1600,res=300, bg='transparent')

ggplot(crypt_bar_plot, aes(y = ypos)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = donor_age, yend = ypos),   color = "grey80",size=1.7) +
  theme_classic()+
  
  ## plot bar for active period :
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = age_earliest_commencement, xend = value, yend = ypos),
    col = 'maroon4',  alpha=1,size=1.7) +
  
  ## plot bar for continuation befond point :
  geom_segment(data=crypt_bar_plot[crypt_bar_plot$timepoint=='age_continuation',],
    aes(x = value, xend = donor_age,  yend = ypos), col = 'maroon4', alpha=0.5,size=1.7) +
  
  
scale_alpha_manual(
  values = c(
    "First positive branch" = 1,
    "Subsequent positive branch" = 0.3
  )
) +
  
  
  ## add points for commmencement / cessation :
  geom_point(data=crypt_bar_plot[crypt_bar_plot$timepoint%in%c('age_earliest_commencement','age_cessation','age_continuation'),],
  aes(x = value,
      y = ypos,
      colour='black',fill = timepoint),
      size = 3.5, colour='black', shape=23,alpha=0.9,stroke=0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  #facet_grid(pdid_f ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = c(
    "age_continuation",
    "age_cessation",
    "age_earliest_commencement"
  ),

    "age_cessation" = "orange1",
    "age_earliest_commencement"='skyblue2'
    
  ),
  labels = c(
    "age_continuation" = "Known Timepoint of Ongoing Exposure",
    "age_cessation" = "Latest Possible Cessation",
    "age_earliest_commencement"="Earliest Possible Commencement")
  ) +
  
  labs(y='Colonic Crypts Grouped by Donor', x='Window for exposure [years]')+
  facet_grid(patient_f~.,scales='free',space='free_y')+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20, 5),minor_breaks = seq(0, 20, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02)))+
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position='bottom',
        legend.title = element_blank()
        )

determine patient level summaries for commencement of exposure :

## summary for timings of exposure :
crypt_bar_plot%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c('age_cessation','age_continuation'))%>% # we derive the latest commencement from end of first branch
  filter(value==min(value))%>% # filter per patient for the first of these
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,age_earliest_commencement,value)%>%
  dplyr::rename(latest_possible_commencement=value)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=contains('commencement'))%>%
  group_by(patient,name)%>%
  summarise(value=median(value))%>%
  group_by(name)%>%
  summarise(median=round(median(value,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            lwr=round(quantile(value,0.25,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            upr=round(quantile(value,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            min=round(min(value,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1))

for age ranges, stipulate the ratio of continuation to cessation :

ages<-c(0,2,5,10,15)
for (i in 2:length(ages)){
  
  time_sum<-crypt_bar_plot%>%
    filter(value> ages[i-1] &value < ages[i] & timepoint %in% c('age_continuation','age_cessation'))%>%
    filter(!duplicated(paste0(patient,value)))%>%
    group_by(timepoint)%>%
    summarise(n=n())%>%ungroup()%>%
    mutate(prop=n/sum(n),ratio= prop/(1-prop))
  colnames(time_sum)<-c('timepoint',paste0('n_',ages[i-1],'_',ages[i]), paste0('prop_',ages[i-1],'_',ages[i]),'ratio')
  print(time_sum)
}
